title: Counting all matroids on ten elements
description:
Source code, recorded counts, and tests for an exact count of matroids on ten elements up to isomorphism. The result is 3,232,000,741,644 unlabeled matroids and 11,727,995,799,397,397,461 labeled matroids. The repository README gives the reproduction commands. The blog post explains the algorithm.

GPT-6 Astra helped discover and implement the optimized algorithms. Sunghyeon Jo read the source code and mathematical proofs and verified the correctness of the algorithms and their implementation.
